title: DeriveBenefitShareRequest
description: The input derive-benefit-share.mjs reads: a value-chain reading (as derive-value-chain-shares-service 0.1.0 returns it), a Crock benefit-sharing record, the units sold, the retail unit price (the net-sales base), a royalty record's licensee-named royalty base, and any caller-named figures that do not fit this schema at all (e.g. a flat per-unit premium the record's share.kind cannot represent), passed straight through into the result's notFound.

unitsSold.description: A decimal string, never a float: the number of units sold this reading computes the total return for.

notFoundInputs.description: Plain descriptive strings naming figures the caller knows about (from the incumbent measurement or the record's own real-world agreement) that do not fit anywhere in this schema and so cannot be computed by this operation; passed straight through into the result's notFound array.

PriceWithUnit.description: A decimal unit price with its unit and citing source row, the same shape derive-value-chain-shares-service's own PriceLadder position price entries carry.
